description: Ollama Client – Chat with Local LLMs Inside Your Browser  A lightweight, privacy‑first extension to chat with local LLMs via Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp. Supports streaming, stop/regenerate, RAG, and easy model switching — all without cloud APIs or data leaks.
